notes: No points until targets and real calibration evidence are published. Null thresholds are never a pass.
Timing uses trusted client clock. TTFT is time to first non-empty text event; TPOT uses independently retokenized visible text. Event gaps are not exact per-token ITL.
Per-run inputs are fresh; only shape warmup is reused. Both profiles get identical measured prompts. Cache hits are permitted and must be reported separately in cache-specific tests.

Model, hardware, dtype, exact chat-template input lengths and maximum output lengths are part of the acceptance contract. Output length is model-determined and recorded; correctness is a prerequisite for counting useful throughput.

Closed-loop structured extraction with shared padding, not general LLM throughput. Common padding prefixes may benefit RadixAttention; dedicated shared/unique prefix on/off tests remain separate evidence.

Neutral decoding is fixed: temperature=0 in requests, SGLang --sampling-defaults=openai, repetition_penalty=1, top_p=1, top_k=-1. Runtime declarations are checked for both profiles; model-inherited sampling defaults cannot be mixed into calibration.

Controller measurement v2 retains explicit request_timeout/upstream_timeout SSE errors as failed timeout rows. Missing or generic error codes remain protocol failures; historical raw rows are never reclassified.
Archived opt-in 1.5B v3 candidate; the current default is 7B v5. No performance targets are published by this historical candidate.
Changes only repeated z padding to a frozen natural-language bank; original v1 extraction instructions, RNG records, strict typed answers, input lengths and output caps remain unchanged.
Causal diagnostic e32ced55: native SGLang 8/8, HF eager 6/8. HF long literal-copy controls still have numeric errors. Qualification64 was NOT run under that original both-paths-pass protocol.

Subsequent decision: HF remains a diagnostic control; validate the actual delivered SGLang service on all64 independent frozen extraction cases before the full new calibration matrix. No raw failures are removed or reclassified.
